prompt:
Edit the supplied paint_mask_guide.png exactly. The guide is the edit target; design_reference.png is the approved material/detail reference and icon_x8.png is the original colour reference (ignore magenta background).
Output ONE transparent PNG, 3:4 canvas, 1536x2048 or nearest 3:4 size. Preserve the guide's three columns by FOUR rows of square cells. Rows 1-2 and rows 3-4 repeat five exact orthographic model views FRONT, BACK, LEFT / RIGHT, TOP, empty. Keep every object exactly at the guide position, size, outline and orientation. Paint only the existing grey objects; do not redraw, enlarge, move or redesign geometry. Preserve all openings and gaps as transparent. Empty cells column 3 rows 2 and 4 remain transparent.
Object: Weregild gold ring with a deep red round cabochon, source-faithful upright hoop plane. Use the gold and red materials of the design reference and native icon, but retain the guide's thin hoop and exact model structure.
Rows 1-2 PAINT: unlit base colours only. Gold metal band and bezel, red gemstone; fine material detail following reference, scaled per view. No lighting, shadows, ambient occlusion, hot highlights, reflections, glow, sparkles, aura, ground, outlines or text.
Rows 3-4 MATERIAL MASK: identical five guide silhouettes filled with FLAT pure colours only. All metal including band, bezel and back of setting = pure red #FF0000. Only visible gemstone surfaces = pure black #000000. No shading, texture, outlines or antialiased colour blends inside. Every silhouette pixel one of these colours and nothing outside. Gemstone may be occluded behind metal in some views: respect the exact guide's visible surfaces.
Preserve transparent background and exact layout with no extra objects.
